positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Develop and refine user experience in enterprise-grade server management tools.

positions.title: Designer
positions.description: Designed  multiple webpages per client specification, created multiple illustrations per client specification, worked collaboratively to produce a language-learning iPhone app

positions.title: Graphic Designer/Multimedia Developer
positions.description:
MOBI provides companies with software and services to manage mobility.

MOBI’s cloud-based software centralizes the management of mobile devices by integrating with wireless carriers, MDMs, corporate IT systems, and more. MOBI’s services help organizations plan for, save on, deploy, support, and decommission mobile devices.

As a result, MOBI’s customers achieve enhanced control, greater visibility, reduced costs, and increased efficiency when managing mobile devices.

• Create high quality multimedia marketing materials including video, audio, and animated presentations.

• Design materials in support of business development and internal initiatives online and in print.

• Create high-quality design templates for company-wide usage in various software programs.

positions.title: Creative Intern
positions.description: Designed quality graphics to support our sales teams, formatted RFI/RFP responses for large accounts, developed corporate branding guidelines, developed corporate logos, designed web and print-based advertisements, designed event promotion graphics, conducted video and photo shoots

volunteerExperiences.description:
Scripted, filmed, and produced short video segments for use during service to rally support for various humanitarian causes.

Additionally, scripted, filmed, and produced video segments to support main points of various messages as needed
